## Introduction

This page shows how life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population changed over time for Japan.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")
country_df = df[df["country"] == "Japan"]

plt.figure()
plt.plot(country_df["year"], country_df["life_expectancy"], label="Life Expectancy")
plt.plot(country_df["year"], country_df["gdp_per_capita"]/1000, label="GDP per Capita (÷1000)")
plt.plot(country_df["year"], country_df["population_millions"], label="Population (millions)")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.title("Japan Over Time")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```
